verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own docs list text, vision, audio, image and embedding models on one platform, with a dedicated vision-model path for analyzing images and documents. The API reference also covers language, image and embedding models, and vision appears in serverless pricing and model recommendations. Audio and image generation, however, rest only on a list-level mention. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of audio (speech/transcription) and image-generation endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multimodal calls.
